findings.failure_path: The final delta returns a P2 finding and covers current HEAD. Opening a PR enters this covered-with-findings branch, which instructs the agent to fix the finding and run another batched delta without checking whether the final delta was already spent. Repeated findings therefore reopen reviewer calls, contradicting development-completion step 3 and the always-on instruction to use test/source proof after that pass.
findings.smallest_fix: Explicitly distinguish fixes before the single delta from disposition after it: once the daily delta has run, require test/source disposition without another reviewer call. Add a reminder probe for a findings receipt from that final pass.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet adds a locator waiver and row digest but omits the code consuming those declarations. It cannot establish that the waiver rejects a new row reusing the locator, an altered historical row, or duplicate uses. Those are the required waiver-abuse checks; the self-review assertion is not inspectable enforcement evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the bounded waiver-consumption logic and inspectable adversarial results showing that only the exact historical row is exempt and altered or reused rows fail.
